title_en: The Second Branch of Beijing Municipal People's Procuratorate v. Shanghai Huaya Company and Ding Fugen et al. — criminal case for manipulation of securities trading prices
keywords_en: Criminal; manipulation of securities trading prices; first instance; intermediate people's court; Beijing; legal person; natural person; criminal law; determination of intent to manipulate securities trading prices; determination of self-dealing behavior; distinction between unit crime and individual crime; whether financing activities constitute manipulation; self-dealing; financing; harboring; securities
full_text_en:
Second Branch of Beijing Municipal People's Procuratorate

v.

Shanghai Huaya Company, Ding Fugen, et al.

— Case of Manipulating Securities Trading Prices

Procuratorial Authority: Second Branch of Beijing Municipal People's Procuratorate

Defendant Unit: Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company. Registered place of business: Pudong South Road, Shanghai.

Defendant: Ding Fugen, male, 37 years old, employee of Zhongke Venture Capital Investment Co., Ltd., residing in Haidian District, Beijing. Arrested on May 18, 2001.

Defendant: Dong Peilin, male, 49 years old, legal representative of Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company, residing in Haidian District, Beijing. Arrested on April 19, 2001.

Defendant: Pang Bo, female, 27 years old, employee of Zhongke Venture Capital Investment Co., Ltd., residing in Xi'an District, Mudanjiang City, Heilongjiang Province. Arrested on April 19, 2001.

Defendant: He Ningyi, male, 45 years old, legal representative of Hangzhou Huaya Industrial Company, residing in Shangcheng District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province. Arrested on May 24, 2001.

Defendant: Li Yun, male, 49 years old, General Manager of Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company, residing in Xuhui District, Shanghai. Arrested on April 19, 2001.

Defendant: Bian Junyong, male, 31 years old, legal representative of Beijing Kewo Technology Co., Ltd., residing in Xuanwu District, Beijing. Arrested on May 24, 2001.

Defendant: Liu Lei, female, 32 years old, unemployed, residing in Haidian District, Beijing. Arrested on May 18, 2001.

The case of the defendant unit Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company and the defendants Ding Fugen, et al. for manipulating securities trading prices, and the defendant Liu Lei for harboring, was initiated by the Second Branch of Beijing Municipal People's Procuratorate by filing an indictment with the Beijing Second Intermediate People's Court on May 9, 2002.

Indictment Allegations:

Between December 1998 and January 2001, Lü Xinjian and Zhu Huanliang (both dealt with separately) conspired to manipulate the tradable shares of the stock named "Kangda'er" (康达尔). To this end, Lü Xinjian successively directed the defendants Ding Fugen, Pang Bo, Bian Junyong, et al., and jointly with the defendant unit Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company and the defendant Dong Peilin, et al., in more than 20 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government, including Beijing, Shanghai, and Zhejiang, to sign cooperation agreements, entrusted financial management agreements, etc., with more than 100 units or individuals in the names of companies such as Zhongke Venture Capital Investment Co., Ltd. and Beijing Kewo Technology Co., Ltd., or in the personal names of the defendants Ding Fugen, Bian Junyong, et al., raising a total of over RMB 5.4 billion. They opened more than 1,500 share accounts at more than 120 securities business departments, including the Shanghai Lujiabang Business Department of Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Co., Ltd. and the Beijing Yayuncun Business Department of Zhongxin Trust & Investment Co., Ltd. Simultaneously, they adopted methods such as self-purchase and self-sale without transferring actual control, and using the purchase of legal person shares of Shenzhen Kangda'er Company, entering the board of directors of the listed company, and releasing information to influence the stock trading price, to jointly or consecutively buy and sell the 0048 stock. During this period, they held or controlled a maximum of over 56 million shares of 0048 stock (accounting for 55.36% of the tradable shares of 0048 stock), seriously affecting the trading price and trading volume of the 0048 stock, thereby manipulating the trading price of the 0048 stock.

The defendant Ding Fugen, knowing that Lü Xinjian intended to manipulate the stock trading price, still, according to Lü's requirements, directly or through directing the defendant Pang Bo, et al., comprehensively managed and allocated the more than 1,500 share accounts opened at more than 120 business departments in more than 20 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government, and the raised funds of over RMB 5.4 billion. He also directly contacted or participated in signing fund-raising contracts, and engaged in activities such as opening accounts, buying and selling securities, transferring custody, designating transactions and revoking designated transactions, depositing and withdrawing funds, closing accounts, and granting sub-authorizations at the business departments as a fiduciary.

The defendants Ding Fugen and Pang Bo also, according to Lü Xinjian's requirements, simultaneously or separately issued buy and sell instructions to the defendants Bian Junyong, Dong Peilin, He Ningyi, Li Yun, Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company, and Hangzhou Huaya Industrial Company and others (or companies) at the controlled 1,500 share accounts and 120 business departments, seriously affecting the trading price and trading volume of the 0048 stock, thereby manipulating the trading price of the 0048 stock.

During his tenure as the legal representative of Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company, the defendant Dong Peilin, knowing that Lü Xinjian needed funds to manipulate stock trading prices, directly or through directing the defendant He Ningyi in the name of Hangzhou Huaya Industrial Company, and the defendant Li Yun in the name of Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company, etc., in Heilongjiang, Zhejiang, Shanghai, and elsewhere, raised a total of over RMB 700 million by signing loan contracts and asset entrusted management agreements with capital-providing units or individuals in the names of Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company, Hangzhou Huaya Industrial Company, etc., or in the personal name of Dong Peilin, and used these funds according to Lü Xinjian's instructions to manipulate stock trading prices.

During his tenure as the legal representative of Hangzhou Huaya Industrial Company, the defendant He Ningyi, under the direction of Dong Peilin, knowing that Lü Xinjian intended to manipulate stock trading prices, successively raised over RMB 320 million in Zhejiang Province by signing loan contracts and other forms with capital-providing units or individuals in the name of Hangzhou Huaya Industrial Company, etc., and directly or through instructing others, conducted buying and selling transactions with the raised funds according to the self-purchase and self-sale requirements of the defendants Dong Peilin, Ding Fugen, Pang Bo, et al., thereby manipulating stock trading prices.

During his tenure as the General Manager of Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company, the defendant Li Yun, under the direction of the defendant Dong Peilin, knowing that Lü Xinjian intended to manipulate stock trading prices, successively raised over RMB 310 million in Shanghai, Jiangxi, and elsewhere by signing loan agreements, asset entrusted management agreements, etc., with capital-providing units or individuals in the name of Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company, etc., and directly or through instructing others, conducted stock buying and selling transactions with the raised funds according to the self-purchase and self-sale requirements of the defendants Dong Peilin, Ding Fugen, Pang Bo, et al.

Under the direction of Lü Xinjian, the defendant Bian Junyong, in order to manipulate stock trading prices, became the legal representative of Beijing Kewo Technology Company established by Lü Xinjian, and used that company's name and others to successively raise over RMB 140 million in Hubei, Beijing, and elsewhere by signing investment entrusted agreements, investment cooperation agreements, etc., with capital-providing units, and directly or through instructing others, conducted stock buying and selling transactions with the raised funds according to the self-purchase and self-sale requirements of the defendants Ding Fugen, Pang Bo, et al.

Between January and April 2001, the defendant Liu Lei, knowing that the defendant Ding Fugen might be investigated by the public security organs for stock manipulation activities, sought a place to hide Ding Fugen, and made two fake ID cards for herself and Ding Fugen to evade arrest by the public security organs.

Procuratorial Authority's Position:

The Procuratorial Authority alleges that the defendant unit Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company and the defendants Ding Fugen, Dong Peilin, Pang Bo, He Ningyi, Li Yun, and Bian Junyong, by manipulating securities trading prices to obtain illegitimate benefits, have violated the provisions of Article 182 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Criminal Law) and constitute the crime of manipulating securities trading prices. The defendant Liu Lei, knowing that Ding Fugen was suspected of committing a crime, provided him with a place of residence and other conveniences, assisting him in evading arrest, thereby violating the provisions of Paragraph 1 of Article 310 of the Criminal Law and constituting the crime of harboring. The Procuratorial Authority requests punishment according to law.

Defenses and Submissions:

Defendant Ding Fugen argued: He did not know that Lü Xinjian intended to manipulate stock trading prices, and he himself had no intention of manipulating securities trading prices. His defense counsel argued: Ding Fugen did not have the intention to manipulate securities trading prices; the acts of "warehouse transfer" and "matched orders" in this case had transferred the ownership of the stocks and did not fall under the circumstances of "self-purchase and self-sale" as defined in the Criminal Law; Ding Fugen was an accomplice in this case.

Defendant Dong Peilin argued: He did not know at the time that Lü Xinjian was manipulating securities trading prices. His defense counsel argued: Dong Peilin's acts were official acts constituting a unit crime; Dong Peilin should only bear the responsibility of the directly responsible supervisor of the unit; Dong Peilin and his company only participated in fund-raising and did not carry out acts of manipulating securities trading prices; Dong Peilin carried out the financing activities only to allow Lü Xinjian to repay legitimate debts; the benefits obtained by his company were intermediary fees for connecting and introducing funds, and they did not obtain illegitimate benefits from stock prices.

Defendant Pang Bo raised no objection to the criminal facts alleged in the indictment. His defense counsel argued: Pang Bo did not participate in planning the manipulation of securities trading prices, and his acts were merely conveying instructions; Pang Bo voluntarily surrendered himself, and it is requested that he be exempted from criminal punishment.

Defendant He Ningyi argued: He did not know beforehand that Lü Xinjian was manipulating securities trading prices. His defense counsel argued: He Ningyi raised funds in the name of his company; the conditions for the six financing loans he participated in were set by Lü Xinjian; he himself was unclear about the source of the pledged funds and the destination of the loans, and was also unclear about the situation of the guarantor units; he did not provide shareholder cards and did not know about the other defendants' manipulation of securities trading prices; it is recommended that He Ningyi be exempted from criminal punishment.

Defendant Li Yun argued: He had no intention of manipulating securities trading prices, nor did he have the capability or qualification to do so; his actions were all official acts; the RMB 5.4 billion financing amount alleged in the indictment involves double counting. His defense counsel argued: Li Yun and Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company did not have the intention to manipulate securities trading prices, and there is no evidence proving that Li Yun manipulated securities trading prices to transfer risks and obtain illegitimate benefits while knowing that Lü Xinjian intended to manipulate stock prices; Li Yun should be acquitted.

Defendant Bian Junyong raised no objection to the criminal facts alleged in the indictment. His defense counsel argued: Bian Junyong was an accomplice, playing a secondary and auxiliary role only, and had a good attitude of admitting guilt with no prior criminal record; it is requested that a suspended sentence be applied to him.

Defendant Liu Lei argued: Because she is the spouse of Ding Fugen, she committed the acts alleged in the indictment, and requests lenient treatment. Her defense counsel argued: Liu Lei's criminal conduct was minor, she admitted guilt and repented, and it was a first offense; it is requested that she be exempted from criminal punishment.

Facts Found by the Beijing Second Intermediate People's Court:

I. Between November 1998 and January 2001, Lü Xinjian and Zhu Huanliang (both dealt with separately) conspired to manipulate the tradable shares of Shenzhen Kangda'er (Group) Co., Ltd. (stock name: Kangda'er A, stock code: 0048, hereinafter referred to as the 0048 stock). The two parties signed a cooperation agreement and jointly held the 0048 stock in an agreed proportion.

Under the direction of Lü Xinjian, the defendants Ding Fugen, Pang Bo, Dong Peilin, He Ningyi, Li Yun, Bian Junyong, et al., in more than 20 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government, including Beijing, Shanghai, and Zhejiang, in the name of units or individuals, successively opened more than 1,500 share accounts at more than 120 securities business departments, including the Shanghai Lujiabang Business Department of Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Co., Ltd. and the Beijing Yayuncun Business Department of Zhongxin Trust & Investment Co., Ltd.; and through relevant securities companies' business departments and other institutions, by means of entrusted financial management, national debt repurchases, and loans, raised over RMB 5 billion in funds from capital-providing units or individuals, which were used to manipulate the 0048 stock. During this period, Lü Xinjian, using companies such as Hainan Yanyuan Investment Management Co., Ltd., Hainan Wohe Biotechnology Co., Ltd., and Minle Yanyuan Investment Management Co., Ltd., extensively acquired legal person shares of Shenzhen Kangda'er (Group) Co., Ltd., and controlled the company's board of directors. Subsequently, Lü Xinjian changed the name of Shenzhen Kangda'er (Group) Co., Ltd. to Shenzhen Zhongke Venture Capital Investment (Group) Co., Ltd. (the stock name was changed to Zhongke Venture), and influenced the trading price of the 0048 stock by releasing "good news" such as developing high-tech products and enterprise restructuring.

In the process of manipulating the 0048 stock, Ding Fugen and Pang Bo, according to Lü Xinjian's instructions, after agreeing with Zhu Huanliang on the time, price, and quantity for trading the 0048 stock, directly or instructed others to trade the 0048 stock. To disperse the number of 0048 shares held and conceal the manipulation of the 0048 stock price, Ding Fugen, Pang Bo, He Ningyi, Li Yun, Bian Junyong, et al., using multiple securities trading accounts and shareholder accounts they had opened, concentrated their capital advantages and shareholding advantages to jointly and consecutively engage in manipulative activities such as self-purchase and self-sale of the 0048 stock without transferring ownership. Lü Xinjian's side held or controlled a maximum of over 56 million shares of the 0048 stock, accounting for 55.36% of the total tradable shares of the 0048 stock, seriously affecting the trading price and trading volume of the 0048 stock. Ding Fugen and others also accepted Lü Xinjian's instructions to obtain profits by trading stocks such as Zhongxi Pharmaceutical, Magang Steel, Laigang Steel, and Suibao Thermal Power, which were used to maintain the stability of the 0048 stock price and repay the huge financing funds.

During his tenure as the legal representative of Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company, the defendant Dong Peilin, knowing that Lü Xinjian intended to manipulate the 0048 stock, still negotiated with General Manager Li Yun and the legal representative of Hangzhou Huaya Industrial Company, He Ningyi, to obtain benefits for their respective companies by helping Lü Xinjian raise funds. Dong Peilin directly or through instructing the defendants He Ningyi, Li Yun, et al., raised a total of over RMB 770 million for Lü Xinjian. Among this, Dong Peilin raised funds through 7 business departments or capital-providing units, including Harbin Tengda Pawnshop and Shenyang General Station Road Business Department of Liaoning Securities Co., Ltd., by means of national debt repurchases and other forms, for a total of over RMB 124 million. He Ningyi, in the name of Hangzhou Huaya Industrial Company, obtained loans from Hangzhou Industrial & Commercial Trust Investment Company and Zhejiang Province Trust Investment Company; in the name of Hangzhou Huaya Real Estate Company and Zhejiang Jinnuo Real Estate Company, obtained loans from units such as Hangzhou City Commercial Bank and Hangzhou Wulin Sub-branch of Huaxia Bank, for a total of RMB 330 million. He Ningyi also, according to Pang Bo's instructions, bought and sold the 0048 stock and stocks such as Suibao Thermal Power and Laigang Steel. Li Yun, in the name of Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company, etc., raised a total of RMB 316 million through 12 business departments, including the Shanghai West Yan'an Road Business Department and Tianping Road Business Department of Haitong Securities Co., Ltd., and the Shangrao Business Department of Jiangnan Trust Investment Company. Li Yun also accepted instructions from Ding Fugen and Pang Bo to buy and sell, or instructed business departments to buy and sell, the 0048 stock and stocks such as Laigang Steel and Magang Steel.

In May and June 1999, the defendant Bian Junyong, knowing that Lü Xinjian intended to manipulate the 0048 stock, assisted Lü Xinjian in registering and establishing Beijing Kewo Technology Co., Ltd., and served as its legal representative. Subsequently, Bian Junyong, in the name of this company or other companies, according to Lü Xinjian's instructions, raised over RMB 150 million in funds, and according to the instructions of Ding Fugen and Pang Bo, purchased or transferred custody of the 0048 stock and stocks such as Magang Steel and Zhongxi Pharmaceutical.

II. From late December 2000 to early January 2001, after the defendant Ding Fugen fled Beijing due to the continuous sharp decline in the price of the 0048 stock, the defendant Liu Lei learned that the actions of Lü Xinjian, Ding Fugen, and others might be suspected of the crime of manipulating securities trading prices. In mid-January 2001, after Ding Fugen returned to Beijing, he told Liu Lei that he needed to find a place to hide. Liu Lei then hid Ding Fugen at Room 502, Unit 7, Building 3, Sipingyuan, Taoranting, Xuanwu District, Beijing, and made fake ID cards for herself and Ding Fugen to evade arrest by the public security organs.

After the case came to light, the defendant Pang Bo surrendered to the public security organs; the defendants Ding Fugen, Dong Peilin, He Ningyi, Li Yun, Bian Junyong, and Liu Lei were arrested and brought to justice.

The above facts are confirmed by the testimony of witnesses including Li Wen, Wang Shaohua, Chen Feng, Zhuang Yan, Mao Weibing, Zhu Wenxue, Ning Xinran, Pan Jing, Miao Fei, and He Shuangyan; documentary evidence including audit reports, business department financing agreements, entrusted financial management agreements, cooperative financial management contracts, fund entrustment agreements, investment entrustment agreements, loan agreements, entrusted monitoring of pledged securities asset agreements, payment guarantee fee contracts for RMB loans, stock pledge financing regulatory agreements, trust asset management contracts, entrusted management of national debt agreements, and comprehensive reports from the Shenzhen Stock Exchange; relevant certifications and expert conclusions issued by the public security organs; statements of the defendants; and fake ID cards. These pieces of evidence were examined in court and confirmed.

Opinion of the Beijing Second Intermediate People's Court:

Article 182 of the Criminal Law stipulates: "Whoever commits any of the following acts, manipulating securities trading prices to obtain illegitimate benefits or transfer risks, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention, and shall be fined, or be fined alone, not less than one time but not more than five times the illegal gains: (1) acting alone or conspiring with others, concentrating capital advantages, shareholding advantages, or utilizing information advantages to jointly or consecutively buy or sell, thereby manipulating stock trading prices; (2) colluding with others, conducting securities transactions with each other at a prearranged time, price, and manner, or buying or selling securities they do not hold, thereby affecting the securities trading price or trading volume; (3) engaging in self-purchase and self-sale without transferring securities ownership, using oneself as the counterparty, thereby affecting the securities trading price or trading volume; (4) manipulating securities trading prices by other means. Where a unit commits the crime mentioned in the preceding paragraph, a fine shall be imposed on the unit, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible for the offense shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention."

Paragraph 1 of Article 310 stipulates: "Whoever, knowing that a person is a criminal, provides him with a hiding place or property, assists him in escaping, or gives false testimony to shield him, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance; if the circumstances are serious, the sentence shall be fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years."

Regarding the charges brought by the Second Branch of the Beijing Municipal People's Procuratorate against the defendant unit Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company and the defendants Ding Fugen, Dong Peilin, Pang Bo, He Ningyi, Li Yun, and Bian Junyong for the crime of manipulating securities trading prices, and the charge against the defendant Liu Lei for the crime of harboring, the facts are clear and the evidence is reliable and sufficient. Ding Fugen, Pang Bo, and Bian Junyong, in order to obtain illegitimate benefits; the legal representative of Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Company, Dong Peilin, and its General Manager Li Yun, in order to enable that unit to obtain illegitimate benefits; and He Ningyi, in order to enable his unit to obtain illegitimate benefits, knowing that Lü Xinjian and others intended to manipulate the 0048 stock price, still adopted various methods to help Lü Xinjian raise funds, and according to Lü Xinjian's instructions, instructed others or directly participated in manipulating the 0048 stock price, seriously affecting the trading price and trading volume of the 0048 stock, infringing upon the state's regulatory system for securities trading and the legitimate rights and interests of investors. The circumstances are serious, and their acts have constituted the crime of manipulating securities trading prices, for which they should be punished according to law. Liu Lei, knowing that Ding Fugen was suspected of committing a crime, still provided him with a hiding place and assisted him in escaping, thereby obstructing judicial authorities in their criminal prosecution of suspects. Her act has constituted the crime of harboring, for which she should also be punished according to law.

Regarding the defenses and submissions of the defendant Ding Fugen and his defense counsel that Ding Fugen did not know that Lü Xinjian was manipulating the trading price of the 0048 stock and that the manipulation was not his intention, upon investigation, the evidence on record proves that as early as the end of 1997, Ding Fugen knew of Lü Xinjian's intention to speculate in the secondary market stocks of listed companies and assisted Lü Xinjian in doing a lot of preparatory work. During the process of manipulating the 0048 stock, Ding Fugen, according to Lü Xinjian's instructions, actively participated in and instructed others to carry out various manipulative activities. The defenses of Ding Fugen and the submissions of his defense counsel lack factual basis and are therefore not adopted.

**Defense counsel for the defendant Ding Fugen submitted that, because the ownership of the shares had been transferred, the acts of "warehousing" and "cross-trading" in this case did not constitute the "self-purchase and self-sale" as prescribed in the Criminal Law. Upon investigation, Ding Fugen and others, in order to manipulate the 0048 stock, opened fund accounts in the business departments of relevant securities companies and illegally opened multiple shareholder accounts under such fund accounts. During the process of manipulating the 0048 stock, although there was a transfer of shares between different shareholder accounts, such transfers either occurred among the illegally opened accounts mentioned above or were related to the manipulative acts of Ding Fugen and others. By conducting transactions in this manner, Ding Fugen and others not only failed to effect a transfer of ownership of the 0048 stock, but also created a false impression of active trading in such stock, thereby affecting investors' judgment of the stock market and the trading price of such stock. The aforementioned transaction conduct of Ding Fugen and others constituted self-purchase and self-sale that did not transfer the ownership of the securities.

**Defense counsel for the defendant Ding Fugen submitted that Ding Fugen played a secondary role in this case and was an accomplice. Upon investigation, during the process of manipulating the 0048 stock, Ding Fugen not only arranged for financing and signed financing agreements, but also, in accordance with the instructions of Lü Xinjian and Zhu Huanliang, issued trading instructions to traders and acted as the agent of authorized persons in multiple business departments, handling matters such as stock account opening, trading, and fund transfers. In June 2000, he also replaced the fund transferor to evade the supervision of the China Securities Regulatory Commission. To fully grasp the situation regarding the control of the 0048 stock price, Ding Fugen also produced materials such as position statements, financing statements, and stock trend charts. Ding Fugen actively participated in the criminal activity of manipulating the 0048 stock from beginning to end, and did not play a secondary role; therefore, he cannot be identified as an accomplice in this case. Accordingly, the aforementioned defense opinions of Ding Fugen's defense counsel are not adopted.

**Regarding the defenses of defendants Dong Peilin and He Ningyi that they were not "aware" at the time of Lü Xinjian's manipulation of the securities trading price, upon investigation, Lü Xinjian explicitly told Dong Peilin of his intention to manipulate the 0048 stock. Dong Peilin has made multiple confessions to this effect, and there is a handwritten statement on file to prove it. Dong Peilin also informed He Ningyi and Li Yun of Lü Xinjian's "new concept" of manipulating the 0048 stock and his need for financing. The three agreed to help Lü Xinjian obtain financing in order to benefit their respective work units. Therefore, the aforementioned defenses of Dong Peilin and He Ningyi are not adopted. Defense counsel for Dong Peilin submitted that Dong Peilin and his company participated in the financing only to enable Lü Xinjian to repay his debts to them, and that the unit received an intermediary fee rather than illegitimate benefits from the financing. Upon investigation, although Dong Peilin and others helped Lü Xinjian obtain financing with the purpose of having Lü Xinjian repay his debts as soon as possible, the debts repaid by Lü Xinjian and the benefits obtained by their company from the financing were all illegitimate benefits derived from the manipulation of the securities trading price by Lü Xinjian and others. Therefore, the aforementioned defense opinion of Dong Peilin's defense counsel is not adopted.

**Regarding the defense of defendant Li Yun that he had no intention to manipulate the securities trading price and lacked the strength to engage in such conduct, upon investigation, the evidence on file shows that Li Yun was fully aware of Lü Xinjian's intention to manipulate the 0048 stock. Nevertheless, in accordance with the consensus reached with Dong Peilin and He Ningyi, he obtained financing for Lü Xinjian in the name of his company, and accepted instructions from Ding Fugen and Pang Bo to buy and sell the 0048 stock as well as shares of Laigang Co., Ltd. and Magang Co., Ltd., among others. His conduct constituted one of the links in the chain of manipulating the securities trading price by Lü Xinjian and others. Li Yun's defense that the alleged financing amount of RMB 5.4 billion involved double counting is unfounded in fact. Therefore, the aforementioned defense of Li Yun is not adopted.

**Defense counsel for the defendant Li Yun submitted that Li Yun and Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Co., Ltd. had no intention to manipulate the securities trading price, that Li Yun's conduct did not conform to the provisions of Article 182 of the Criminal Law, did not constitute the crime of manipulating the securities trading price, and that Li Yun should be acquitted. This defense opinion lacks factual and legal basis and is not adopted.

**The defenses and defense opinions of defendant Pang Bo and his defense counsel regarding Pang Bo's voluntary surrender; the defense opinions of the defense counsels for defendants Dong Peilin, He Ningyi, and Li Yun that the conduct of Dong Peilin, He Ningyi, and Li Yun was official conduct constituting a unit crime; and the defense opinion of Liu Lei's defense counsel that Liu Lei's criminal circumstances were minor: upon investigation, these are found to be true and are adopted. Dong Peilin, He Ningyi, and Li Yun are all directly responsible persons in charge of their respective units and shall bear corresponding criminal liability according to law. Pang Bo voluntarily surrendered after the incident and is given a lighter punishment according to law. Liu Lei's criminal circumstances are minor and may be exempted from criminal punishment.

Accordingly, the Beijing Second Intermediate People's Court rendered the following judgment on April 1, 2003:

1. Defendant Unit Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Co., Ltd. is guilty of the crime of manipulating the securities trading price and is sentenced to a fine of RMB 23,000,000.

2. Defendant Ding Fugen is guilty of the crime of manipulating the securities trading price and is sentenced to four years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 500,000.

3. Defendant Dong Peilin is guilty of the crime of manipulating the securities trading price and is sentenced to two years and ten months' imprisonment.

4. Defendant He Ningyi is guilty of the crime of manipulating the securities trading price and is sentenced to two years and six months' imprisonment.

5. Defendant Li Yun is guilty of the crime of manipulating the securities trading price and is sentenced to two years and six months' imprisonment.

6. Defendant Bian Junyong is guilty of the crime of manipulating the securities trading price and is sentenced to two years and two months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 220,000.

7. Defendant Pang Bo is guilty of the crime of manipulating the securities trading price and is sentenced to two years and three months' imprisonment, suspended for two years and six months, and a fine of RMB 100,000.

8. Defendant Liu Lei is guilty of the crime of harboring and is exempted from criminal punishment.

9. The seized property and articles shall be confiscated or returned respectively, and the illegal gains shall continue to be recovered.

After the judgment of the first instance was pronounced, defendant Li Yun refused to accept it and filed an appeal; the other defendants did not appeal.

Li Yun's grounds for appeal were: he did not manipulate the securities trading price for Lü Xinjian and others; he did not obtain illegitimate benefits; and his conduct did not constitute a crime. His defense counsel argued that Li Yun had no subjective intent to manipulate the securities trading price, did not obtain illegitimate benefits, and his conduct did not constitute a crime.

The Beijing High People's Court, upon trial, held:

Regarding Li Yun's appeal that the first instance judgment incorrectly characterized the facts, that he was not aware of Lü Xinjian and others' manipulation of the securities trading price, that he did not obtain illegitimate benefits, and that his conduct did not constitute a crime, and the defense opinion of Li Yun's defense counsel that Li Yun lacked subjective knowledge, had no subjective intent to manipulate the securities trading price, did not obtain illegitimate benefits, and his conduct did not constitute a crime: Upon investigation, Dong Peilin repeatedly confessed, "In September 1998, Lü Xinjian told me to help him raise funds. I told him that he wanted to trade the 0048 stock, to be a long-term market maker, and that he would do so by acquiring the equity of listed companies and improving their performance. He needed funds. We could help Lü Xinjian raise funds and make money by trading stocks with him, and we would also give the financiers some benefits. I asked Li Yun to help Lü Xinjian raise funds in Shanghai, and he agreed. Li Yun contacted the financing money. I told Lü Xinjian the conditions, and Lü agreed. He told me to contact Ding Fugen. I called Li Yun and told him to contact Ding Fugen. A few days later, Li Yun called me and said Ding Fugen had gone to Shanghai and the financing deal was concluded." "Every time Li Yun finalized a financing deal, he would tell me. I would then ask Lü Xinjian for money, and Lü Xinjian would tell me to contact Ding Fugen. To make sure Li Yun understood that the financing was for the company, I had Ding Fugen remit the money to the account of Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Co., Ltd." Dong Peilin's handwritten statement proves that Lü Xinjian told him he intended to manipulate the 0048 stock and needed financing, and that Dong Peilin informed Li Yun of this, and Li Yun agreed. Ding Fugen and Pang Bo both testified that they personally gave instructions to Li Yun to purchase the 0048 stock and other stocks. A large body of evidence proves that Li Yun was fully aware of Lü Xinjian and others' manipulation of the securities trading price, and that he provided significant financing and conditions for Lü Xinjian's manipulation. The funds received by Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Co., Ltd. and the benefits derived by the company from the financing all came from the illegitimate benefits obtained by Lü Xinjian and others after manipulating the securities trading price. Appellant Li Yun had previously admitted that Dong Peilin said Lü Xinjian was the market maker manipulating the 0048 stock, and that he proposed helping Lü Xinjian raise funds. Li Yun helped Ding Fugen, or in the name of Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Co., Ltd. or in his personal name, sign financing contracts with securities company business departments such as the Shanghai Yan'an Road Business Department of Haitong Securities Company, raising a total of RMB 310 million. Therefore, the grounds of appeal of appellant Li Yun and the defense opinion of his defense counsel lack basis and are not adopted.

In summary, the first instance court, based on the facts, nature, circumstances, and degree of social harm of the crimes committed by defendant unit Shanghai Huaya Industrial Development Co., Ltd. and defendants Ding Fugen, Dong Peilin, Pang Bo, He Ningyi, Li Yun, Bian Junyong, and Liu Lei, rendered its judgment. The facts are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, the conviction is accurate, the sentence is appropriate, and the trial procedure is lawful. The Beijing High People's Court, pursuant to the provisions of Article 189(1) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the PRC, rendered the following ruling on June 16, 2003:

The appeal is dismissed and the original judgment is affirmed.
